settings.label: 最高音质
settings.help: 限制请求的最高档位：播放器要求更高时降到所选档位，要求更低时保持原样。对外部音源和官方取流都生效。

settings.label: Login method
settings.help: Enter QQ or WeChat. Leave empty for QQ.

settings.label: Use external source
settings.help: Resolve the audio link from an LX source first, then fall back to official playback. No external request is made while this is off.

settings.label: LX script URL
settings.help: Full LX script URL starting with https://, e.g. https://source.shiqianjiang.cn/api/script/lx?key=… . The plugin reads the declared endpoint only and never executes the script.

settings.label: Backup LX script URL
settings.help: Backup LX script URL. Automatically tried when the primary script fails.
